map.PI = X / Y，其中X为可疑父亲是生父的概率，Y为随机男子是生父的概率。: PI = X / Y, where X is the probability that the suspected father is the biological father and Y is the probability that a random man is the biological father.
map.PI > 1 支持亲权关系，PI < 1 不支持亲权关系。: PI > 1 supports parentage, while PI < 1 does not.
map.CPI = 各基因座PI的乘积。CPI > 10000 通常可认定亲权关系（标准: CPI = the product of the PI across loci. CPI > 10000 usually establishes parentage (standard: CPI > 10000).
map.W = CPI / (CPI + 1)，表示可疑父亲是生父的概率。: W = CPI / (CPI + 1), the probability that the suspected father is the biological father.
map.当检材含2个或以上个体DNA时，STR图谱中单个基因座可检出超过2个等位基因。: When the sample contains DNA from 2 or more individuals, a single locus in the STR profile can yield more than 2 alleles.
map.2人混合斑：每个基因座最多4个等位基因峰。已知一人分型后可推算另一人分型。: A 2-person mixed stain yields at most 4 allele peaks per locus. Once one person's profile is known, the other can be inferred.

map.按各 STR 基因座计算亲权指数 PI（PI=X/Y，X 为可疑父亲是生父概率、: Compute the paternity index PI per STR locus (PI = X/Y, with X the probability the suspected father is the biological father and Y the probability for a random man), the cumulative paternity index CPI as the product of the per-locus PI, and the paternity probability W = CPI/(CPI+1). A CPI > 10000 usually establishes parentage.
map.15 个常染色体 STR 基因座 CPI=15000：W=15000/15001: CPI = 15000 across 15 autosomal STR loci: W = 15000/15001 = 99.99%, supporting the suspected father as the biological father. If at a locus the child carries a mandatory allele the father does not have, that locus gives PI ≈ 0 and parentage is excluded overall.
map.这是常用阈值但非绝对；需排除近亲、突变（突变率约 0.1%~0.2% 可致单座不: It is a common threshold but not absolute. Close relatives, mutations (a mutation rate of about 0.1% to 0.2% can cause a single-locus mismatch), sample contamination and maternal mismatching must be ruled out and judged together with the case.
map.混合斑如何判定人数？: How is the number of contributors to a mixed stain determined?
map.统计各座最高等位基因数（杂合峰面积比）估算贡献者人数，需峰高均衡、无 stutt: Estimate the contributor count from the maximum allele count per locus (heterozygous peak area ratios), requiring balanced peak heights and no stutter interference. Complex mixtures need quantitative modelling and cannot rely on peak counts alone.
